text:
Arun V.: Heads-up: following the Docker quickstart (starter-app) against a freshly created SSO org. Build + run succeed but the first API call returns 403. Error body says billing_required but console billing page shows 'Billing is available for Enterprise customers only' and no add-card button. admin is me and I can see no option to enable billing. Anyone seen an 'enterprise-only' gate for new orgs?
Lila (devex): ouch. that phrasing is new. can you paste the exact request and response?
Arun V.: minimal example from inside container:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-temp-abc" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-mini-1","input":"hello"}'
```
response: 
```json
{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"Workspace 9001: billing disabled for this organization. Contact sales to enable billing for your plan."}}
```
Arun V.: billing page: https://console.redwood.example/orgs/9001/billing shows a card that says 'Billing: Enterprise only. Talk to sales' and a link to contact-sales. No add-card CTA anywhere.
Marco (billing): that text indicates the org was auto-assigned plan=enterprise_restricted by the provisioning rule because the org domain matches our partner allowlist. Those orgs are expected to go through sales enablement, not self-serve. Did the org come from a partner SCIM integration or a manual mapping?
Arun V.: it was created via SSO SCIM by infra; i didn't know partner mapping existed. we expected self-serve.
Lila (devex): two things: 1) quickstart should surface clearer guidance when the 403 maps to 'enterprise_restricted' vs normal billing_required. 2) provide a short troubleshooting step for devs/admins: how to request temporary self-serve so they can finish a quickstart.
Marco (billing): workaround for internal teams: support can flip plan to self_serve_temp via support admin console (internal only). I'll open a request and leave a note for infra to avoid partner mapping on internal domains.
ops-bot: Created ticket BILL-7821: "Auto-mapped partner domains blocking self-serve billing for new SSO orgs" assigned to billing-provisioning.
support-bot: Support ticket SUP-4102 created to flip org 9001 to self_serve_temp (pending manual approval).
Arun V.: flipping to self_serve_temp would be great — I just want the quickstart to pass for internal testing.
Lila (devex): i'll add a quick line in the Docker quickstart README: "If you get 403 with message 'billing disabled for this organization', your org may be on an enterprise-only mapping — contact your infra or open a support ticket."
Marco (billing): long-term: infra should include `provisioning_reason` in SCIM metadata so we can avoid partner mapping for internal projects. filing infra ticket.
Arun V.: thanks, opening PR to add the troubleshooting note now. once support flips plan i'll re-run and report back. :thumbsup:
Lila (devex): also adding an analytics event for 'billing_required::enterprise_restricted' so dx team can see how many quickstarts hit this.
Arun V.: update: support flipped the org to self_serve_temp; quickstart returned 200 after card was added. closing here, thx everyone.
